title: Workshop Allowances for Model Changes, Extensions and Lease Exchanges on the Equipment Rental and Demo Line
content:
## Changes, extensions and lease exchanges, Equipment Rental and Demo

The workshop holds, for each package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line, whether changes of model are inside the package, what a change costs where it is not, how many changes one agreement may carry, whether an agreement on the package may be extended, what an extension costs and by how many days it may run, and whether kit held on a season lease may be exchanged for another size.

| Package | Changes of model inside the package | Change fee | Changes allowed on one agreement | Extension allowed | Extension fee | Extension limit, days | Lease exchange allowed | Lease exchange fee |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | no | 15.00 USD | 1 | yes | 10.00 USD | 7 | no | 0.00 USD |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | no | 15.00 USD | 1 | yes | 10.00 USD | 7 | no | 0.00 USD |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | no | 12.00 USD | 2 | yes | 12.00 USD | 7 | no | 0.00 USD |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | yes | 0.00 USD | 3 | yes | 18.00 USD | 5 | no | 0.00 USD |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | yes | 0.00 USD | 5 | no | 25.00 USD | 0 | no | 0.00 USD |
| Season-Long Lease Package | no | 45.00 USD | 2 | no | 0.00 USD | 0 | yes | 45.00 USD |

### The columns defined

The first column says whether the guest may change to a different model during the agreement at no charge. The change fee is the fee in USD for changing to a different model during the agreement where changes are not inside the package. The third column is the number of times the kit on one agreement may be changed for a different model. The extension columns say whether an agreement for the package may be extended while the kit is out, the fee in USD for extending it charged on top of the rate for the extra days, and the most days one agreement may be extended by. The last two columns say whether kit held on a season lease may be exchanged for another size during the season, and the fee in USD for that exchange.

### How the allowances sit against one another

The allowance of changes widens up the line, from 1 on the Junior and Basic packages to 5 on the Demo Ski & Board Rental, and the money attached to a change falls away over the same run, from 15.00 USD to nothing at all. The two packages that carry changes inside them, the Performance and Demo packages, are the two that show a change fee of 0.00 USD.

Extension runs the other way. The Junior, Basic and Sport packages may each be extended by up to 7 days, the Performance package by up to 5, and the Demo Ski & Board Rental and the Season-Long Lease Package not at all, their extension limits standing at 0 days. The Demo package nevertheless carries an extension fee figure of 25.00 USD against its name, the highest of the line, and the Season-Long Lease Package a figure of 0.00 USD.

The Season-Long Lease Package is the one package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line on which a lease exchange is allowed, at 45.00 USD; every other package shows the exchange as not allowed and a fee of 0.00 USD. Its change fee, also 45.00 USD, is the dearest change of the line.
